svg.title: A fair integer-summary comparator keeps Hamming weight W = ∑︁ i Yi, not the needlessly large identity summary. W is a single integer-linear row with b + 1 attainable values (the paper’s symmetric box would contain 2b + 1). It is sufficient for this target. A standard exact count-histogram dynamic program stores last bit and current weight. At length t it has 2t nonzero integer cells.
